references.text: Eglon is mentioned as one of the five Amorite kings who allied against Gibeon and were later defeated by Joshua.
The king of Eglon was one of the five kings hidden in a cave at Makkedah and later executed by Joshua.
Describes the conquest of Lachish, the city Joshua left to attack Eglon, following the same pattern of siege and capture.
Shows the same conquest pattern continuing after Eglon, as Joshua and all Israel move on to Hebron.
Eglon is listed among the defeated kings that Joshua and the Israelites struck down.
Eglon is mentioned as one of the cities allotted to the tribe of Judah as an inheritance.
